Yes—**DonorDock does have online giving**. DonorDock’s Online Giving pages let organizations collect donations online, and gifts submitted through those pages are automatically recorded in DonorDock.[1][2]

It also supports **branded giving pages**, **embedded donation forms**, and **standalone donation pages** for campaigns, events, memberships, and general giving.[1][5][8]

If you want, I can also tell you whether it supports **recurring donations**, **Stripe/PayPal**, or **website embedding**.
